customProducts.name: Badam Haluwa
customProducts.fullDescription: Handcrafted with pure avocado oil, farm-fresh regenerative harvests, and zero seed oils.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Serve piping hot immediately upon arrival.
customProducts.storage: Keep warm or refrigerate up to 48 hours.

customProducts.name: Warm Molten Belgian Choco Lava Cake
customProducts.tagline: Warm Dark Chocolate Sponge with Erupting Liquid Truffle Core
customProducts.shortDescription: Rich single-origin Belgian cocoa cake with a warm flowing dark chocolate center, dusted with icing sugar.
customProducts.fullDescription: Baked with 70% dark Belgian couverture chocolate. The exterior is a soft delicate cocoa sponge cake, while the molten center erupts with warm, rich liquid chocolate fudge at the touch of a spoon.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Warm for 10 seconds in microwave for maximum molten flow.
customProducts.storage: Keep at room temperature or refrigerate for up to 3 days.

customProducts.name: Amritsari Kesar Pista Matka Lassi
customProducts.tagline: Churned Thick Curd with Saffron, Pistachios & Thick Malai Top
customProducts.shortDescription: Creamy whole milk yogurt churned with madhani, infused with royal Kashmiri saffron, green cardamom, and toasted Iranian pistachios.
customProducts.fullDescription: Hand-churned in traditional wooden churners (Madhani). Prepared using sweet organic whole milk curd, steeped saffron, and rose water. Served in a cooling clay kulhad with a thick crown of malai cream and slivered dry fruits.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Drink chilled straight from the earthen kulhad for authentic rustic mineral taste.
customProducts.storage: Delivered ice-cold in thermal insulated bag. Consume within 6 hours.

customProducts.name: Double Cheese Burst Margherita Sourdough Pizza
customProducts.tagline: 48-Hour Cold Fermented Crust with Liquid Cheese Core & Mozzarella
customProducts.shortDescription: Stone-baked pizza with molten cheddar cheese crust, Italian San Marzano tomato sauce, and 100% pure Fior di Latte mozzarella.
customProducts.fullDescription: A cheese lover's dream! Stuffed with molten liquid cheese inside the blistered sourdough crust, topped with fragrant Italian tomato puree, fresh sweet basil leaves, virgin olive oil, and golden baked stringy mozzarella.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Sprinkle with oregano seasoning and chilli flakes.
customProducts.storage: Delivered at 80°C in thermal ventilated pizza box.

customProducts.name: Crispy Korean Nashville Fried Chicken Burger
customProducts.tagline: 24-Hour Buttermilk Marinated Crispy Fried Chicken Fillet
customProducts.shortDescription: Mega-crispy double-dredged chicken thigh fillet tossed in honey paprika glaze with creamy cabbage slaw.
customProducts.fullDescription: Boneless whole chicken thigh soaked in spiced buttermilk for 24 hours, double-coated in seasoned flour and flash-fried to astronomical crunchiness. Drizzled with hot honey glaze and topped with creamy house slaw in toasted sesame bun.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Enjoy hot with garlic mayo dip.

customProducts.name: Double Melt Gourmet Smash Cheese Burger
customProducts.tagline: Twin Searing Patties with Melted Aged Cheddar & Secret Burger Sauce
customProducts.shortDescription: Two crispy-edged smashed patties, molten American cheddar, caramelized grilled onions, dill pickles on toasted brioche.
customProducts.fullDescription: Prepared using prime ground meat smashed ultra-thin on a 500°F cast iron flat-top. Double layered with aged cheddar, house secret umami sauce, crisp iceberg lettuce, and sweet caramelised onions inside golden butter-toasted brioche buns.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Best paired with Peri Peri French Fries and a Chilled Belgian Chocolate Shake.
customProducts.storage: Delivered hot in ventilated burger dome box.

customProducts.name: 👑 Royal Saffron Shahi Dum Handi
customProducts.shortDescription: Slow cooked in clay handi with pure saffron & desi ghee.
customProducts.fullDescription: Slow cooked in clay handi with pure saffron & desi ghee.
customProducts.servingSuggestion: Serve piping hot immediately upon arrival.
customProducts.storage: Keep warm or refrigerate up to 48 hours.

reviews.comment: The Shahi Awadhi Dum Biryani arrived steaming hot in a clay handi! Incredible taste.
The Awadhi Dum Biryani arrived steaming hot in a sealed clay handi! The aroma of Kashmiri saffron filled the room. Truly a royal 5-star experience.

reviews.favoriteDish: Double Melt Gourmet Smash Cheese Burger
reviews.comment: Best smash burger in town! The brioche was perfectly toasted, and the melted cheddar pull was insane. Peri-peri fries were still hot and crunchy!
Ghar jaisa authentic swaad! Surti Undhiyu and thepla were cooked to perfection in pure cow ghee. The Kesar Shrikhand was sublime.

reviews.favoriteDish: Warm Molten Belgian Choco Lava Cake
reviews.comment: The chocolate lava cake literally erupted warm gooey truffle ganache at the touch of a spoon. Paired with iced caramel macchiato, it was pure bliss.
